property.name: Text 1
property.value: Stand firm-but never allow patience to become inaction.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Wood is an element of growth and endurance. It draws strength from the ground beneath it, recovering where others would weaken. Strong roots can survive even the harshest conditions. But roots planted too deeply can also become restraints.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Overcome my three trials and prove nature answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You've learned how wood endures and draws strength from the battlefield. Now you'll learn what happens when even the strongest roots are threatened.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: For your final trial, you'll wield the Wood element yourself. Prove nature still answers to you when standing firm is no longer enough.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You held your ground when it mattered and moved when it did not. You've proven yourself worthy of Wood.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Take this chip. Let it serve as proof that nature answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Not bad, but you haven't cleared the trial yet. Try again and show me what you've learned.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: So, you opened the Security Cube. That means Protoman may make his move soon, and we'll need to be prepared when that time comes. I think it's time you mastered the elements. It's the most basic form of training.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Each of us specializes in one of the four elements. Pass our trials, and you'll be ready for what's ahead. Let us begin.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: So, you've passed every trial. You’ve now mastered all four elements. Our training is complete. When Protoman makes his move, put everything you've learned to use.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Strike hard-but don't let your power make you careless.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Fire is an element of power and destruction. It consumes the battlefield, reducing anything in its path to ash. A true Fire Navi can stand where others would be burned. But no flame burns without limits.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Overcome my three trials and prove the flame answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You've learned how fire overwhelms its enemies. Now you'll learn what happens when the flame is pushed to its limit.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: For your final trial, you'll wield the Fire element yourself. Prove the flame still answers to you when the tide turns.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You faced the flame at its strongest and stood firm when its power was tested. You've proven yourself worthy of fire.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Take this chip. Let it serve as proof that the flame answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Adapt to the battlefield-but never let it choose your course.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Aqua is an element of movement and adaptation. It flows through the field in multiple states and it has the power to stop you in your tracks or take control away from you. One must be able to change with the current to control it

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Overcome my three trials and prove the tide answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You've demonstrated that you're capable of changing with the current. Now it's time to prove that even when the current takes you to a path of danger, you can take it head on and overcome it

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Get ready...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You moved with the current without allowing it to carry you away. You've proven yourself worthy of Aqua.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Take this chip. Let it serve as proof that the tide answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Move quickly-but never faster than your judgment.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Elec is an element of speed and precision. Its power races through water, and even the smallest opening can carry its force. A true Elec Navi can withstand the shock without losing momentum. But speed without control disappears in a flash.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Overcome my three trials and prove the lightning answers to you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You've learned how lightning finds an opening and strikes before it closes. Now you'll learn what happens when the charge meets something that refuses to yield.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: For your final trial, you'll wield the Elec element yourself. Prove the lightning still answers to you when speed alone is not enough.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You carried the charge without allowing it to control your actions. You've proven yourself worthy of Elec.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Take this chip. Let it serve as proof that the lightning answers to you.
